spec_source: 汪老師 2026-11-17 meeting：輸入＝欲比對的段落＋ref，限定 IEEE 格式，使用者自己貼上
ground_truth_scope: 只有解析層（ref 編號、配對數、缺少 ref、未被引用 ref）。支持層級未標註，需人工讀被引文獻後補。

cases.paragraph:
Password-Free Authentication and Secure Backup: To enable secure and password-free authentication, researchers should adopt FIDO2/WebAuthn
standards [79].
cases.references: [79] "Device onboarding overview," Fido Alliance, 2021. Accessed: Apr. 4, 2025. [Online]. Available: https://fidoalliance.org/device-onboarding-overview/
traps: 原文跨行：從 PDF 複製會在 'FIDO2/WebAuthn' 後產生硬換行，未修版 parser 會把引用句截成只剩 'standards [79].'（patch 0001 的回歸測試）
cases.notes: 篇名是 device onboarding，主張是 password-free authentication，屬灰色地帶，適合測「不確定」級，但正確答案需人工定。 被引來源是 W3C 規格與 FIDO Alliance 網頁，索引裡沒有摘要（2026-11-22 實測）。

cases.paragraph: Innovative Proof Reuse and Revocation: Existing solutions utilize W3C [47], [107], [109], [110] standards for VCs, VP generation, and revocation.
cases.references:
[47] "Verifiable credentials data model v1.1," W3C. Accessed: Aug. 9, 2024. [Online]. Available: https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model/
[107] "Verifiable credentials data model v2.0," W3C. Accessed: Aug. 9, 2024. [Online]. Available: https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model-2.0/
[108] "General data protection regulation (GDPR)," European Union, 2018. Accessed: Mar. 23, 2025. [Online]. Available: https://gdpr.eu/
[109] "Verifiable credentials overview," W3C. Accessed: Aug. 9, 2024. [Online]. Available: https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-overview/
[110] "Verifiable credentials bitstring status list," W3C. Accessed: Aug. 9, 2024. [Online]. Available: https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-bitstring-status-list/
traps: 一句四個編號，測複合引用拆解
ref 清單含未被引用的 [108]，不可配對給任何引用
cases.notes: 已是 repo mock_data.py 的 MOCK_CLAIM / MOCK_REFERENCES 預設值。 被引來源是 W3C 規格與 FIDO Alliance 網頁，索引裡沒有摘要（2026-11-22 實測）。

cases.source: 研方paper/A Multi-Agent Framework for Citation Hallucination Detection.pdf
cases.paragraph: Commercial citation auditors such as Citely [9], SwanRef [26], CiteCheck [8], and RefCheck-AI [20] report only a binary Real-or-Fake label [30], and academic auditors such as CiteAudit [24] query multiple bibliographic APIs but still emit the same binary verdict, so the ambiguous middle ground collapses into the same yes/no signal. Open tools such as Hallucinator [25] consult more than ten bibliographic databases in parallel, but key the verdict on title and author and leave venue, year, DOI, pages, and publisher unaudited. GPTZero's hallucination mode [13] does cross-check external sources, but audits only five fields.
cases.references:
[8] CiteCheck. CiteCheck: Ai-powered citation verification. https://citecheck.ai/, 2024. Accessed: 2026-04.
[9] Citely. Citely: AI citation assistant. https://citely.ai/, 2024. Accessed: 2026-04.
[13] GPTZero Team. GPTZero: Detecting AI-generated text, 2023.
[20] RefCheck-AI. RefCheck-AI. https://github.com/HuaHenry/RefCheck_ai, 2024. Accessed: 2026-04.
[24] Kaiwen Shi, Weixiang Sun, Zheyuan Zhang, Lichao Sun, Nitesh V Chawla, and Yanfang Ye. Citeaudit: You cited it, but did you read it? a benchmark for verifying scientific references in the llm era. arXiv preprint arXiv:2602.23452, 2026.
[25] Gianluca Stringhini. Hallucinator: A citation hallucination checker. https://github.com/gianlucasb/hallucinator, 2024.
[26] SwanRef. SwanRef: Reference verification platform. https://www.swanref.org/, 2024. Accessed: 2026-04.
[30] L. J. Janse van Rensburg. Ai-powered citation auditing: A zero-assumption protocol for systematic reference verification in academic research, 2025.
traps: 三句八個引用，每個編號緊貼工具名稱，拆句或配對偏移會立刻顯現
[24] 的 ref 含問號 'did you read it?'，測句尾判斷不會誤切
cases.notes: 支持層級需人工讀被引文獻後標註。 ⚠️ 2026-11-22 更正：原本標為 is_real_ieee=true，實際核對原論文後確認這篇用的不是 IEEE 格式。段落與引用編號仍是真實的，可用於配對層測試，但不可用來代表 IEEE 格式的 ref。
cases.ref_style: plain／ACM 式：作者在前、篇名不加引號。方括號編號相同，但不是 IEEE 格式

cases.source: 研方paper/A Multi-Agent Framework for Citation Hallucination Detection.pdf
cases.paragraph: Recent venues documented widespread fabricated references in submitted papers, with third-party tooling flagging dozens of cases per session [12, 27]; ICLR 2026 assembled a desk-reject queue of submissions whose bibliographies contained hallucinated citations [11]; and ACM CCS 2026 published a Transparency Report enumerating the citations its review cycle flagged as AI-fabricated [1].
cases.references:
[1] ACM CCS 2026 Program Committee. Transparency report on AI-generated citations in ACM CCS 2026 submissions. https://github.com/ACM-CCS-2026/Transparency-Report, 2026. Accessed: 2026-05.
[11] GPTZero. GPTZero finds over 50 hallucinations in ICLR 2026 submissions. https://gptzero.me/news/iclr-2026, 2025.
[12] GPTZero. GPTZero flags fabricated citations in NeurIPS submissions. https://gptzero.me/news/neurips/, 2025. Accessed: 2026-05.
[27] The Register. AI conference's papers contaminated by AI hallucinations. https://www.theregister.com/2026/01/22/neurips_papers_contaiminated_ai_hallucinations/, 2026.
traps: [12, 27] 是逗號分隔複合引用，和 case2 的 [47], [107] 是不同寫法，IEEE 兩種都合法；目前無任何測試覆蓋
三個子句用分號串接而非句號，測拆句不會誤把分號當句尾
cases.notes: 最重要的一筆。若 parser 只認各自獨立方括號，[12, 27] 會整個漏掉或被當成不存在的編號。 ⚠️ 2026-11-22 更正：原本標為 is_real_ieee=true，實際核對原論文後確認這篇用的不是 IEEE 格式。段落與引用編號仍是真實的，可用於配對層測試，但不可用來代表 IEEE 格式的 ref。
cases.ref_style: plain／ACM 式：作者在前、篇名不加引號。方括號編號相同，但不是 IEEE 格式

cases.paragraph: Prior work established the baseline accuracy of automated reference checking [3], and a later replication reported substantially lower precision on non-English corpora [91].
cases.references: [3] A. Author and B. Writer, "Automated reference checking at scale," IEEE Trans. Knowl. Data Eng., vol. 12, no. 3, pp. 45-60, 2024.
traps: [91] 內文有、ref 清單沒有，必須輸出 ReferenceMatchStatus.MISSING_REFERENCE
不可把 missing_reference 算成「不支持」——取不到來源與內容不支持要分開計數
cases.notes: 對應汪老師 11/3 標準：取不到來源不是幻覺。評估的 confusion matrix 需要獨立類別。

cases.source: paper-reading/paper-temp-storage/Enabling Secure and Scalable GDPR Compliant Blockchain Based e-KYC With Efficient Redaction.pdf（IEEE Access，DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3594656）：Related Work 的 redaction 段
cases.ref_style: 嚴格 IEEE：[21] 用 ‘‘…’’，[27][28] 用 "…"，同一篇論文混用兩種引號
cases.paragraph:
Xu et al. [21] incorporated trapdoor hash functions in their
PRHBS system to facilitate secure and flexible redactions
in the healthcare sector. In [27], The authors introduced
a secure, efficient, and accountable data management approach utilizing a redactable blockchain. They also developed a distributed trapdoor recovery mechanism that ensures
both efficiency and accountability. Recently, Wang [28] et
al. present a redactable blockchain framework that supports
both transaction-level and block-level rewriting.
cases.references:
[21] J. Xu et al., ‘‘A Privacy-Preserving and Redactable Healthcare Blockchain System,’’ IEEE Transactions on Services Computing, vol. 17, no. 2, pp. 364–377, Mar.-Apr. 2024, doi: 10.1109/TSC.2024.3356959.
[27] Y. Xu et al., "Redactable Blockchain-Based Secure and Accountable Data Management," in IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management, vol. 21, no. 2, pp. 1764–1776, April 2024, doi: 10.1109/TNSM.2023.3352561.
[28] Y. Wang, H. Peng, J. Duan, L. Wang, X. Hu and Z. Zhao, "Resilient and Redactable Blockchain With Two-Level Rewriting and Forgery Detection," in IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, vol. 20, pp. 1163–1175, 2025, doi: 10.1109/TIFS.2024.3250830.
traps: 「Xu et al. [21]」、「Wang [28] et al.」的 al. 不可當句尾
「… sector. In [27],」句號後接大寫 In，是真的句尾，要切開
同一篇論文混用兩種引號，篇名都要抽得到
cases.notes: 著者對 [21][27][28] 的描述具體（trapdoor hash、distributed trapdoor recovery、two-level rewriting），適合做內容查證的正確答案標註。

cases.source: paper-reading/paper-temp-storage/Enabling Secure and Scalable GDPR Compliant Blockchain Based e-KYC With Efficient Redaction.pdf（IEEE Access，DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3594656）：Related Work 的隱私保護段
cases.paragraph:
In addition to supporting data redaction, several models prioritize privacy-preserving mechanisms to protect user
anonymity. Heo et al. [16] introduced zk-SNARKs to enhance
privacy by generating one-time cryptographic keys for transactions, ensuring that user identities cannot be tracked.
cases.references: [16] W. J. Heo et al., ‘‘Decentralised Redactable Blockchain: A Privacy-Preserving Approach to Addressing Identity Tracking Challenges,’’ 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency (ICBC), Dublin, Ireland, 2024, pp. 215–219, doi: 10.1109/ICBC59979.2024.10644348.
traps: 第一句沒有引用，不可產生查核項目
被引文獻篇名是 Decentralised Redactable Blockchain，沒有 zk-SNARK 字樣——篇名判斷會很吃力
cases.notes: 篇名不含 zk-SNARK，但內容應該有。適合用來測「篇名不相關就停止」這條規則會不會誤殺。

cases.source: paper-reading/paper-temp-storage/Enabling Secure and Scalable GDPR Compliant Blockchain Based e-KYC With Efficient Redaction.pdf（IEEE Access，DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3594656）：Related Work 的 IPFS 段
cases.paragraph:
The integration of revocable IPFS with redactable
blockchain models is another noteworthy approach to improving data management and ensuring compliance. Yeh et al.
[14] leveraged revocable IPFS to enable selective removal of
files, maintaining both privacy and usability in their GDPR-
compliant framework. Guo et al. [17] employed a similar
method for managing EHRs, enabling rapid redactions and
ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.
cases.references:
[14] L.-Y. Yeh et al., ‘‘GDPR-Compliant Personal Health Record Transmission With Redactable Blockchain and Revocable IPFS,’’ IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing, vol. 21, no. 4, pp. 3342–3356, 2024, doi: 10.1109/TDSC.2023.3259071.
[17] H. Guo et al., ‘‘Decentralized Electronic Health Records Management via Redactable Blockchain and Revocable IPFS,’’ 2024 IEEE/ACM Conference on Connected Health, Wilmington, DE, USA, 2024, pp. 167–171, doi: 10.1109/CHASE60773.2024.00028.
traps: 「Yeh et al.\n[14]」引用編號被硬換行切到下一行
「GDPR-\ncompliant」行尾連字號必須接回去，不可變成 GDPR- compliant
cases.notes: 這是從 PDF 直接複製的原始換行，包含行尾連字號。

cases.source: paper-reading/paper-temp-storage/Enabling Secure and Scalable GDPR Compliant Blockchain Based e-KYC With Efficient Redaction.pdf（IEEE Access，DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3594656）：實驗結果段
cases.paragraph:
Figs. 2 and 3 present the authentication, proof generation,
and verification times across different schemes. Scheme [2],
relying on RSA, incurs the highest computational cost due
to expensive modular exponentiations. Scheme [6], though
secure with quantum key mechanisms, suffers from significant overhead caused by quantum network setup and key exchange protocols. Scheme [13] improves efficiency by using
elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) with hashing and modular
addition, but still faces moderate overhead from ECC operations.
cases.references:
[2] S. Fugkew, ‘‘Enabling Trust and Privacy-Preserving e-KYC System Using Blockchain,’’ IEEE Access, vol. 10, pp. 49028–49039, 2022, doi: 10.1109/ACCESS.2022.3172973.
[6] G. M. Faruk Ahmed et al., ‘‘Enhancing e-KYC Security and Privacy: Harnessing Quantum Computing and Blockchain in Web 3.0,’’ Distributed Ledger Technologies: Research and Practice, 2024, doi: 10.1145/3686166.
[13] K. Takaragi et al., ‘‘Secure Revocation Features in eKYC-Privacy Protection in Central Bank Digital Currency,’’ IEEE Transactions on Fundamentals of Electronics, Communications, and Computer Sciences, vol. 3, 2023, pp. 325–332.
traps: 「Figs.」後面的句號不可當句尾
第一句沒有引用編號，不可產生查核項目
cases.notes: 這段是對被引文獻「效能特性」的主張，要驗證得讀被引文獻的實驗節。
